title: Social Media Strategy
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Social Media Strategy, Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Students will be able to create and manage content tailored for various social media platforms, utilizing best practices for audience engagement and brand alignment.
Students will demonstrate the ability to analyze social media metrics and engagement data to assess the effectiveness of campaigns, using insights to refine strategies and improve content visibility.
Students will be equipped to develop and implement basic social media marketing strategies that align with organizational goals, including audience targeting, scheduling, and performance evaluation.

notes: The overview calls the award the 'Social Media Strategist Certificate of Achievement' while the heading reads 'Social Media Strategy, Certificate of Achievement'.

The description says the certificate prepares students 'for careers that involve using social media to promote products, individuals, and organizations'. This was read as a general description rather than a named career or career field, so careers is left empty. A reviewer may want to check this.
The page is marked 'Not Financial Aid Eligible'.
The catalog prints no separate block total for Required Core. The award total of 18 units is printed as 'Total Units 18'.
